notes: MLXUI-authored (PF-9, SPEC-Q251, owner ruling 2026-11-18) -- catflow-mlx has no manifest for this model yet, so this was written from translategemma-4b-it-4bit.json's shape. tasks is ["Redact"] only: the model is the first .redact catalog entry and RealExecutor's .redact branch serves that row alone. The one setting, only=, is a comma-separated subset of person, email, phone, url, address, date, account, secret; the default is all eight (decision 7), and RealExecutor refuses any other key and any unknown category by name, never silently ignoring one. resources.disk_gb is browser.json's downloadSizeGB (2.83, the five files the loader reads: model.safetensors 2798989498 B + tokenizer.json 27868174 B + config.json + tokenizer_config.json + viterbi_calibration.json) and resources.ram_gb is its provisional ramGB 4.2 (the catalog's 1.5x weights estimate; the measured booking lives in ModelLoadProfile's .redact row, PF-8).
